what: When the pointer is over a photo, a 104px background-color circle follows the cursor position with no delay and scales from 0 to 1 over .3s ease-out on entry (back to 0 over the same duration on exit). Inside the circle is small uppercase text (MORE, 12px · letter-spacing .1em), and a ring around it spreads to 1.2x and fades every 1.5s. It is active only within 650px of the panel’s top edge, so it is off over the caption panel below the photo. None on touch devices

options.text: Text inside the circle, default MORE
options.band: Lit only within this height (px) from the panel’s top edge, default 650 — none means the whole panel
options.--fx-dur: On and off duration (via style), default .3s
options.--fx-pulse: Duration of one ring spread (via style), default 1.5s
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: When placing the circle yourself (if not, the part creates it)

from.where: shared.js .ok-card .ok-more-area · index.html .ok-book__slide .ok-more-area (attached to the panel wrapping the photo link, so the circle sits beside the link (performance·exhibition record photos. Original: top/left via mousemove, isActive only within 650px above the panel, transform .3s ease-out scale(0↔1), ::before ring 1.5s infinite scale 1→1.2 · opacity 1→0, 104px · #080d1b)
